title: 第2章 回县城
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
系统？

    金手指？

    李西海猛然瞪大眼睛，整个人不受控制的颤抖起来。

    拿手机的手，都在摇摇欲坠，根本拿不稳。

    没吃过猪肉，还没见过猪跑吗？

    番茄那么多系统文，系统金手指，不都是主角的标配啊。

    没想到自己也有这一天。

    我特么也能有系统？

    也成主角了啊！

    他很快冷静下来，这方面的心理素质早就被番茄小说给千锤百炼过。

    “系统！”

    “在。”

    “股市怎么预知的？”

    “一支标的，在预知之中，会给出未来所有的曲线走向，包括最高点，最低点，开盘价，收盘价，利空利好因素，场内场外等等，辅助投资者能够做出最正确合理的投资选择。”

    “卧槽，这么强大。”

    完全就是开天眼了，想亏都不可能。

    闭着眼睛投资都会赚的啊。

    “为什么只有一次预知？”

    “投资者的资金不达标，一百万以内，每月只有一次机会。”

    “达到一百万，五百万以内，每月有三次机会。”

    “达到五百万，满足一千万，每月有六次机会。”

    系统：“资金越多，投资者可预知标的越多。”

    李西海微微思索，问道：“有没有可能达到无限制预知？”

    “可以。”

    系统：“请投资者努力获取投资资金。”

    “多少资金？”

    “投资者自行探索，本系统无可奉告！”

    好一个无可奉告。

    你行。

    “要是预知标的亏损怎么办？”

    “等下一个月。”

    李西海：“……”

    行吧。

    他大致是搞清楚，预知能力的情况。

    盈亏自负呗。

    这个月不行，下个月再来。

    没关系，反正我现在有的是时间。

    ……

    第二天。

    李西海还在睡梦中，就被电话给吵醒了。

    一看时间，都快十点了。

    昨天晚上有点略显激动，很晚才睡着。
content_en:
system?

    Goldfinger?

    Li Xihai's eyes suddenly widened, and his whole body began to tremble uncontrollably.

    The hand holding the phone was shaky and couldn't hold it steady at all.

    Have you never eaten pork or seen a pig running?

    Tomato has so many system articles and system cheats. Aren’t they all standard features for the protagonist?

    I never thought that this day would come to me.

    How can I have a system?

    He has become the protagonist!

    He calmed down quickly. This aspect of his psychological quality had been tempered by Tomato novels.

    "System!"

    "Here."

    "How to predict the stock market?"

    "An underlying asset, in advance, will give all the future curve trends, including the highest point, lowest point, opening price, closing price, negative and positive factors, on and off the market, etc., to assist investors in making the most correct and reasonable investment choices."

    "Fuck, so powerful."

    It’s just that my eyes have been opened, and it’s impossible to lose money.

    You can make money by investing with your eyes closed.

    "Why only one prediction?"

    "Investors whose funds do not meet the standard, less than one million, only have one opportunity per month."

    "If you reach one million, or within five million, you have three opportunities every month."

    “To reach five million, to meet ten million, there are six opportunities a month.”

    System: "The more funds, the more investors can predict the target."

    Li Xihai thought for a moment and asked, "Is it possible to achieve unlimited prediction?"

    "Okay."

    System: "Investors are requested to work hard to obtain investment funds."

    "How much money?"

    “Investors can explore on their own, this system has no comment!”

    Well, no comment.

    You can do it.

    “What should I do if I predict a loss in the underlying asset?”

    "Wait for next month."

    Li Xihai: "..."

    OK.

    He roughly figured out the situation of his precognitive ability.

    You are responsible for your profits and losses.

    If not this month, come back next month.

    It doesn't matter, I have plenty of time now anyway.

    ……

    the next day.

    Li Xihai was still asleep when he was woken up by the phone call.

    Looking at the time, it was almost ten o'clock.

    I was a little excited last night and fell asleep very late.
